verdict.line: You lose if you let him freely enrage and cash in E stacks for free waveclear; you win by trading when his shield is down and chunking him with Maiden before he out-scales.

brief.thesis: Sion's E (Enrage) has no cooldown, so every point he spends burning health for AD is a choice you can punish by forcing extra trades, while his only real defensive tool, W (Death's Caress), is on an 8-second cooldown and has to be timed or detonated to matter. The 44.7% head-to-head over 85 games says Sion players are winning the patience war; Yorick's job is to make every trade cost Sion more health than it costs you via Q (Last Rites) heal and E (Mourning Mist) armor shred.

theirWindow.when: W shield is up and charging
theirWindow.what: He can walk up and detonate it into you for free poke with no real risk; back off or bait it out with a minion before committing your Q.

yourWindow.when: his W is on cooldown (8s) or just popped
yourWindow.what: This is your trade window: land E (Mourning Mist) for the armor shred and slow, then Q (Last Rites) for the bonus damage and heal. He has no shield and no stun available if Q (Cryptic Gaze, 12-8s CD) is also down.

powerCurve.note: Trading cautiously, both testing E damage
Enrage stacks and kills add up fast
W wall and E shred punish his all-ins
Maiden pressures him off farm hard
Trinity Force spikes close the health gap

start.why: Sion's Enrage autos and Q poke chip you down over the laning phase; the flat damage reduction on the shield absorbs exactly that kind of repeated small-hit trading, and it's the higher-win-rate start at 63.3% over Doran's Blade.

boots.why: Sion's damage is almost entirely basic attacks once Enrage is active, and Steelcaps' attack damage reduction directly undercuts that scaling; it's the more-picked and better-performing boot at 53.5% over 43 games.

core.why: Gives the stats and proc damage to actually win extended trades against a champion stacking max health.
Sion builds tanky off Enrage kills, so the armor shred and attack speed from Cleaver keep your damage relevant into the mid game.
Cooldown reduction lets you throw out Q and E more often in extended trades, which is where you out-value his Enrage spend.

situational.when: you are ahead and want to push structures and split push off the back of Maiden pressure
he is stacking max health fast and you need armor pen to keep trades even
you want a bigger burst on your first extended trade window before his shield is back up

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp sustains you through poke trades and scales your max health, which matters directly against a champion whose win condition is also stacking max health off kills; it's the higher-pick-rate page at 42.9% usage and 23.7% pick rate. Master-tier Yorick players instead run Conqueror (991 games) for the sustained-damage adaptive force stacking, which suits a more aggressive trading player who wants to win extended fights rather than farm safely to scaling items.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the most-run and highest-picked combo at 65.8% pick rate, letting you reset off bad trades and still reach lane in time to contest his push; Flash+Ignite is close behind at 45.2% win rate for players who want to force earlier all-ins while his W is down.

playing.title: Trade only when his W is down
playing.detail: Death's Caress is only an 8-second cooldown but it absorbs a real chunk of your damage; wait for it to be on cooldown or baited onto a minion before committing Q.

playing.title: Use W to wall off his engage
playing.detail: Dark Procession (20-12s CD depending on rank) blocks enemy movement outright; drop it when he commits to Cryptic Gaze range so he can't close the stun distance.

playing.title: E first in every trade
playing.detail: Mourning Mist's armor shred and slow make every following auto and Q hit harder and stick longer; throwing E before Q maximizes the damage of the combo.

playing.title: Watch his Q cooldown after he whiffs it
playing.detail: Cryptic Gaze is 12/11/10/9/8s; if he misses it, you have a clean window of that length to force a trade without fear of the stun.

playing.title: Don't greed for last hits under his E stacks
playing.detail: Enrage lets him burn health for free AD on demand; if he's actively stacking it near the wave, back off rather than contest the minion.

playing.title: Save ultimate timing for post-6 skirmishes
playing.detail: Eulogy of the Isles' Maiden lets your attacks on her target deal bonus damage; use it to win straight 1v1 trades rather than holding it purely for split push.

playing.title: Respect his R once he hits level 6
playing.detail: Cannibalism (90s CD) heals him and grants attack speed on hit; all-ins that looked winning pre-6 can flip once he has it up, so check his ult icon before committing.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tactical reasoning — trade timing, cooldown windows, and power-curve calls — is the author's own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Use [E] to contest lane while being careful of his (E) – (Q). Although it is difficult to time, [W] can be used to interrupt (Q).
